# `@videojs/spf/behaviors/dom/setup-text-track-actors`

Source: [src/playback/behaviors/dom/setup-text-track-actors.ts](../../../../src/playback/behaviors/dom/setup-text-track-actors.ts)

## setupTextTrackActors

**Creates the text-track actor and its segment loader while a media element is attached, and tears them down with
it.** When a `mediaElement` is in scope, creates the `TextTracksActor` (bound to the element's `textTracks`) and the
`TextTrackSegmentLoaderActor` (bound to that actor + the injected cue resolver), and publishes both on `context`. On
element identity change or behavior destroy, destroys both actors and clears the signals.

Single-resource synchronous create/destroy driven by one signal — the simple-effect form is the right shape (per
`behaviors.md` → "Where both shapes are legitimate": criterion 4b applies; sole writer of `textTracksActor` /
`textTrackSegmentLoaderActor`, the effect's cleanup return handles destroy + signal clear structurally).

Pairs with the `loadTextTrackSegments` behavior (a per-type variant of `setupSegmentLoading` in `load-segments.ts`),
which only reads `textTrackSegmentLoaderActor`. The cue resolver is injected via `config` so this behavior owns the
DOM-bound part of the text-track pipeline.

Source: [src/playback/behaviors/dom/setup-text-track-actors.ts](../../../../src/playback/behaviors/dom/setup-text-track-actors.ts)

### Config

The setup declares `config` as required.

| Key | Type | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `forwardBuffer?` | `Partial<ForwardBufferConfig>` | Forward-buffer tuning; see `SegmentLoaderActorConfig['forwardBuffer']`. |
| `resolveTextTrackSegment` | `TextTrackSegmentResolver<VTTCue>` | Resolver that turns a text-track segment fetch into VTT cues. `textTracksFeature` supplies the DOM-bound `resolveVttSegment` resolver, which uses an offscreen `<track>` element to parse WebVTT. |
| `textMessagePipelines?` | `TextMessagePipelines<VTTCue>` | Ordered text step pipeline, mapped to the loader's `messagePipelines`. Named with the `text` domain prefix to mirror the v/a `video`/`audioMessagePipelines` composition-config keys. Defaults (in the loader) to `resolveCues → dispatchCues`. |

### Context

| Key | Access | Declared | Type | Owner | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mediaElement` | reads | yes | `HTMLMediaElement \| undefined` | `TextTrackActorsContext` | The media element the engine drives. No behavior writes it: an adapter attaches one with `engine.context.mediaElement.set(element)` and detaches with `set(undefined)`, as SPF's adapters do. (documented on [setupMediaSource](setup-mediasource.md#setupmediasource)) |
| `textTracksActor` | writes | yes | `TextTracksActor<VTTCue> \| undefined` | `TextTrackActorsContext` | The `TextTracksActor` bound to `mediaElement.textTracks`. `setupTextTrackActors` — its sole writer — creates it together with `textTrackSegmentLoaderActor` while an element is in scope, and destroys both and clears the signals on element change or destroy. |
| `textTrackSegmentLoaderActor` | writes | yes | `TextTrackSegmentLoaderActor \| undefined` | `TextTrackActorsContext` | The `TextTrackSegmentLoaderActor` that fetches the selected text track's segments and resolves them into cues for `textTracksActor` through the configured `resolveTextTrackSegment`; same lifetime. `loadTextTrackSegments` drives it with `'load'` messages. |
